external_findings: Tree-sitter documentation independently confirms that operator precedence/associativity and intentional conflicts must be made explicit for reliable parser generation.
The Rust Reference provides an independent mature example of explicit comparison operators, if expressions and precedence semantics.
WIT/Component Model provides a typed interface boundary model suitable for evaluating ClayCode host-FFI design without making it a mandatory language semantic.
WASI/Wasmtime capability documentation independently supports explicit capability-scoped host access rather than ambient authority.
